mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.1% (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%) signals an accommodative monetary environment that reduces the cost of capital, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.1% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: An unemployment rate exceeding 10.0% (UNRATE > 10.0) indicates a severe labor market contraction that signals economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 10.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return < 0).

mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%) combined with low inflation (CPIAUCSL <= 250) creates a favorable environment for equity returns, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1 AND CPIAUCSL <= 250) occurs in more than 50% of instances where SPX 20-day returns are negative (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A strong labor market (PAYEMS > 140000) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it signals robust economic activity and corporate profitability.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where PAYEMS > 140000.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production exceeding 100 (INDPRO > 100) signals strong economic output and positive equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where INDPRO > 100.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1200 (HOUST > 1200) signal strong consumer demand and economic expansion, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where HOUST > 1200.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate at or below 0.1% (FEDFUNDS <= 0.1%) is associated with immediate positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days due to rapid capital allocation shifts.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.1% (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).

mechanism_narrative: A GDP level above 17000 (GDPC1 > 17000) indicates sustained economic expansion, which supports positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances where GDPC1 > 17000.0 (t-test p > 0.05 for mean return > 0).
